notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.content: Small Visual updates to the leaderboards

- Global leaderboard added as well as friends leaderboard (updated visuals to come this week).

- New Physics update that makes combos easier!

- Small adjustment to the sizes of the balls for game balance.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3
notes.content:
- Friends Leaderboard added in-game! You can compete with your friends and check how much more Blitzing you have done than them.

- Visuals for Leaderboard will be adjusted soon but I wanted to make sure you all had access to the feature ASAP!
